summary: Purble Place entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Purble Place

emulation.notes: Use original OS media/license where possible.

primary.why: Purble Place is a Microsoft Windows pack-in game, not a normal current storefront title. The archive route is a Windows Vista or Windows 7 installation or VM that preserves the original bundled game behavior.
primary.how_to_play: Use a Windows Vista/7 machine or VM with the original Microsoft Games component enabled. Record OS edition, VM/hardware state, display scaling, game selected, difficulty, score/progress, and whether any unofficial extraction was avoided or separately labeled.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record OS edition and VM/hardware state; do not treat browser clones or extracted copies as the official route.
